An ad-free GUI with a full-height download graph, a speed-limit field that fits long values, and a rebranded banner.

## Changed

- **New README banner wordmark.** "JDownloader" is now set in Bree Serif — our house wordmark font (as on BombVault / ShipLog) — instead of the generic Arial Black, so the banner reads as our brand. Claim set in Lato, the shared claim font across all repos.
- **Ad-free by default.** JDownloader's built-in advertisements are now switched off out of the box: the bottom **"Become premium user" banner** (which sat between the speed line and the progress area and squeezed the download graph's height), the **premium-alert** column nags, the status-bar **"+ premium"** button, and the **special-deal** popups. Only advertisements are touched — the Donate button and every functional setting are left exactly as you set them. The flags live in `org.jdownloader.settings.GraphicalUserInterfaceSettings` (e.g. `bannerenabled`); they are re-applied on each start so a JDownloader self-update can't quietly bring the ads back.

## Fixed

- **Speed-limit field clipped long values.** The speed-limit field in the *Settings* menu had a fixed width sized to fit only "500.00 KB/s" (JDownloader hardcodes it in `MenuEditor.getEditorWidth()`), so a higher limit such as "10,216 MiB/s" was cut off and unreadable. The bundled GUI agent now relaxes that fixed width and grows the menu so the whole value, including its unit, is shown.

## Notes

- Both changes apply automatically — **Force Update** the container (or `docker pull`) and restart. No template or settings change is needed; existing downloads and config are untouched.
